03 / A DIFFERENT FEEL

Less plastic
in the picture.
More possibility.

Warm. Tactile. Unmistakably fiber. We’re exploring a plant-based material system that feels closer to paper and bamboo than a conventional shaker.

Our ambition is industrial compostability for the whole assembly—including the barrier and closures. The material recipe, testing and certification are still ahead.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Honest answers.

Can I buy a Spira bottle yet?

Not yet. This is an early look at the product we’re developing. There’s no confirmed launch date, and we’re not taking orders or collecting emails here.

Is it already certified compostable?

No. Whole-assembly industrial compostability is a design goal. The body, moisture barrier and closures need to be developed and qualified together. Local facility acceptance would also matter; home compostability is not being claimed.

What does the helix do?

The concept uses ribs formed into the inside wall to encourage movement while shaking. There’s no separate mixing ball. Mixing performance with different supplements still needs physical testing.

What still needs to be tested?

Leak resistance under vigorous shaking, thread durability, food-contact suitability and 24-hour containment under both refrigerated and room-temperature conditions. The serving target is 16–20 fl oz, with allowance needed for powder and mixing headspace.

Will the final bottle look exactly like this?

The interactive model shows our current design direction. The natural-fiber formulation, barrier, rib construction and manufacturing details may change as we prototype. Images and animations are concept previews.
